title: Empty logs say 'No log rows match these filters' when no filter is on
where: /admin/sessions/daily-life-together/logs (a session with no AI calls yet), 1440px
what_happens: With Status 'all' and Kind 'all', the page says '0 of 0 matching calls' and 'No log rows match these filters.', under a row of four Status chips all at 0.
who_hurts: Dane may think a filter is hiding rows and start clicking chips, when the session simply has no calls yet.
suggested_fix: When no filter is set and the session total is 0, show 'No AI calls yet for this session.' and hide the filters (logs/page.tsx:218).
rule: general: empty state should say why it's empty
